details: Definition. Stability has an unbounded cost even on classes admitting proper stable schemes: on singletons psUSC is $\Theta(n)$ while pUSC is two for $n\ge3$.
witness_verification: The database-owned singleton values give $\lceil(n-1)/2\rceil\le\mathrm{psUSC}\le n-1$ and $\mathrm{pUSC}=2$ for $n\ge3$. Thus the ratio diverges; this is not a nonexistence-versus-finiteness example.
proof: Proper stable unlabeled compression adds stability to proper unlabeled compression. Restricting the allowed compression functions cannot decrease the minimum size.
name: Proper Stable Sample Compression / Proper Unlabeled Sample Compression
